contract: Compare the AC-3 and E-AC-3 syncframe header view with av_ac3_parse_header and the AC-3 parser's output, including dependent syncframes in grouped packets.

Fold kind 3 with source offset, syntax, bitstream ID, declared byte extent, rate, audio block count, audio coding mode, LFE flag and actual byte extent. Fold kind 8 with offset on a refused syncframe. Coding mode and LFE come from the fixed wire header where the parser does not expose those codes.
